title: MinuteX - AI meeting notetaker app with a recorder device
description: MinuteX is an AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes meetings into clear, shareable minutes. Its mobile app captures conversations on the go and syncs recordings from the MinuteX clip-on recorder device.
about: I built the MinuteX mobile app with the team at PT LinkIT 360, bringing the MinuteX web portal to Android and iOS with React Native and Expo. I owned the integration with the MinuteX recorder device. My contributions include:
about_list: Built a native Expo module in Kotlin and Swift that connects the app to the MinuteX recorder device over Bluetooth Low Energy.
Controlled recording from the app, synced the device clock, and showed device status such as battery level and an ongoing-recording notification.
Synced recordings the device captured on its own: converted its Opus audio into Ogg files, uploaded them for AI transcription, and cleared them from the device.
Added Sign in with Apple, terms, privacy and AI consent screens, and in-app account deletion.
Kept the app launching on iOS 26, enabled background recording, and replaced blank-screen crashes with an error screen.
project_results: The app is available in beta on Google Play and iOS TestFlight. Results while I was on the project:
project_results_list: Recordings from the MinuteX device reach transcribed meeting minutes without a laptop.
Shipped releases 0.1 through 0.6.1 for Android and iOS, with over-the-air updates tied to each app version.
Covered the device audio codec and Ogg file writer with unit tests.

title: LullaDream - AI bedtime story app for children
description: LullaDream turns a child's name, favourite animal or wildest dream into a one-of-a-kind bedtime story, narrated by a parent's own recorded voice or by AI voices. It runs on Android, iOS, tablets and the web.
about: I was the main contributor to the LullaDream Flutter app at PT LinkIT 360, and worked across the Go backend, the Next.js web app and the CMS wherever a mobile feature needed it. My contributions include:
about_list: Built features across the Flutter app: library search and filters, a story player that keeps narrating in the background with notification controls, voice recordings, favorites, and notifications.
Designed tablet and foldable layouts with a navigation rail and a two-pane story player, while keeping the phone layout unchanged.

Built App Store in-app purchases end to end: StoreKit subscriptions and coin top-ups in the app, and backend endpoints that verify Apple-signed transactions, process App Store Server Notifications V2, and reconcile subscriptions every hour.
Split purchased coins from subscription coins in the backend ledger, so coins a parent buys never expire.
Added Google sign-in for Android through App Links in the app and web app, and Sign in with Apple on iOS.
project_results: LullaDream is available on Google Play, and its iOS app supports App Store subscriptions and coin top-ups. Results while I was on the project:
project_results_list: Shipped app releases up to version 1.10, including big-screen support for tablets and foldables.
Handled App Store billing edge cases in the backend: refunds, billing retries, ended trials, and plan upgrades.
Made production the default build target, guarded by a test, so a store release can never point at staging.

title: ISIPAS - Functional app for PPOB, fuel vouchers and rewards
description: ISIPAS is a PPOB app for mobile credit, data, electricity, water bills, e-wallet and game top-ups. Users also buy MyPertamina fuel e-vouchers and collect Pastamp rewards for discounts on their next voucher.
about: I started the ISIPAS app at PT LinkIT 360 from my own Flutter boilerplate and connected it to the backend, while a teammate built most of the screens from the design mockup. My contributions include:
about_list: Set up the app with Clean Architecture and BLoC, and kept each feature independent of the shared core code.
Connected sign-in, registration, PIN, biometrics and Google sign-in to the backend, first through the existing Via API and then through the ISIPAS API.
Wired the purchase flows for mobile credit, data, PLN, e-wallet and games to live products, with QRIS payment and invoices built from the order history.
Integrated MyPertamina e-voucher checkout and Pastamp redemption, and kept My Vouchers available offline in an encrypted on-device cache.
Added Sentry observability: a trace for every REST and GraphQL call, purchase-funnel metrics, and session replay that masks voucher codes, QR codes and electricity tokens.
project_results: The app reached a signed alpha build for the Play Console. Results while I was on the project:
project_results_list: Took the app from an empty project to a signed alpha release in under two weeks.
Made production the default build, with staging and an in-memory mock backend chosen per build, so a typo cannot point a release at the wrong server.
Gave the app its ISIPAS launcher icons and splash screens, including dark mode.

title: HeyMika - AI study companion app for learners
description: HeyMika is an AI study companion for Indonesian learners. Upload study material, get AI summaries, quizzes and flashcards, and study together with Mika, a friendly manga kitten tutor. Available on the web and as a native Android app.
about: HeyMika is a platform with a web app (heymika.web.id), built by another developer, and a native Android app. I build the Android app on my own, from design system to feature modules. My contributions include:
about_list: Built the Android app in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose with clean architecture and Koin dependency injection.
Turned the Google Stitch mockups into a reusable design system with its own theme tokens and components.
Split features into dynamic feature modules delivered on demand through Play Feature Delivery.
Stored data locally in an encrypted Room database and processed study material in the background with WorkManager.
Mapped the Android data layer to the web platform's API, so the app can later switch from a fake backend to the real one.
project_results: This app is still in development and has not been released to the public yet. Progress so far:
project_results_list: Finished the design system, authentication, password recovery and study material workspace.
Covered the core with 350+ unit tests and a CI pipeline that checks lint, tests and release builds.
Shipped a working debug build for testing, with a fake backend that can be swapped for the real web API.

title: SellGo - Functional app for field sales management
description: SellGo is a work app for promoters and field sales teams. Attendance with selfie and GPS, daily activities, sales records, and transparent KPI scores are in one app and visible to supervisors and company admins.
about: I built this app from scratch as a freelance mobile developer for PT Shelter Indonesia, in a 3-month cycle. My contributions include:
about_list: Built the whole Android app in Flutter with Clean Architecture and BLoC state management, so it stays modular, testable, and scalable.
Built attendance with camera-only selfie and face detection, matched against the assigned work location and radius with GPS.
Built daily activity checklists with photo proof, and sales records with draft, validation status, and photo evidence.
Built the KPI score screens with grades from A to D and a point breakdown for each indicator.
Wrote the project documentation for the company, including the proposal, man-days per feature, and system reports.
project_results: This app is published on the Google Play Store and is used by field sales employees of companies that use SellGo. Results while I was on the project:
project_results_list: Released on the Google Play Store with a company-managed account flow and no public sign-up.
Gave supervisors and admins live visibility of attendance, activities, and sales through the web dashboard.
Kept the app privacy-friendly: location is read only while attending, and photos are resized on the phone before upload.
